title: Vietnam veteran's survivor guilt

tellings.quote: there was one guy when I was a very young doctor who was in Vietnam and they were in a firefight and

plain: A Vietnam veteran who had been in a firefight carried deep guilt over having survived it. Greg Rogers, a doctor who worked for NASA, tells the story second-hand. The man was a patient Rogers saw when he was a very young doctor, and Rogers shares it to show how such experiences stay with a person.
